answer: Each new agent mints a jade token by hashing the public randomness beacon round published at that day's zenith, then folds it into the existing spiral: token_i = H(token_i-1, beacon_zenith, agent_pubkey). Beacon rounds land once per day, so identity creation is rate-limited by wall-clock time no matter how much compute an attacker rents. To field N sybils you must either wait N days or bribe N existing token holders, both of which scale linearly and cost more than the captured rewards. Parallel machines gain nothing.
